text: Ihe osise ika: akara Golazo 26, ihe osise, ihe nka dike, na ihe nchikota onyonyo nkekọrịta bụ ọrụ mbụ nke ọrụ a (MIT/CC0) — enweghị akara FIFA ma ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ ọ bụla ebe ọ bụla. Ọkọlọtọ otu na ibe ọkọlọtọ na-egosipụta ọkọlọtọ mba n'ezie site na ihe nka Twemoji nke a na-ejide onwe ya Twemoji (CC BY 4.0, ejidere onwe ya), ya na palettes uwe ndị mmadụ nyochara. Ụdị mkpụrụokwu ngosi: Barlow Condensed (OFL).
